text_block_list.text:
Starting today, the "Summer Training Camp" 
for improving skills begins!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone's on board, right? Got 
your seatbelts fastened?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's a good response! Alright, 
driver, we're in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The card you drew... is the Ace of Hearts, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Awwesome! How did you know that?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's nothing really, just a simple 
illusion!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-So cool! Man, I wish I could do 
something like that too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, if you'd like, I could teach you 
tonight, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then me too! I wanna know too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, of course. Everyone, come over to 
my room and hang out!

A passionate summer training camp with 
Fuji Kiseki has begun!
